Continuing to match anchors: found matches at (6,-1), (8,5), (9,9), (10,1), confirming shapes cover rows through 11. Now I'm checking whether all foreground cells across the grid have been accounted for by these anchors.

Next I try shifting all anchors by +3 to see if that produces a consistent tiling, listing new anchor positions and starting to draw the resulting 12x12 grid, filling in cells for anchors at (3,0), (2,4), and (2,10).

Continuing to fill in the remaining rows: r7 covers cols3-5, r8 adds cols3,4,8,9,10, r9 spans 0,1,3,5,8,9, r10 has 0,8,10, and r11 covers 1,5,6,7.
